tp4-mtp.qualification: Qualified through 32 sequences, the default: MTP with three draft tokens on the zai-org FP8 checkpoint, at TP4, FP8 KV and DCP 1, with images. qual.json's checks passed in GATES4 (part A, the autoregressive arms, at cab96b599; part B at 8c75e90bd), adopted by the operator on 2026-10-11, except the soak: host growth 1,077.5 MiB. The soak's 512 MiB host-growth limit is waived for the bounded warm-up of pinned last-chunk prefill programs (at most 64 lengths, about 2.5 GiB host over a server's life); GPU memory for all 64 stays free after the KV pool.

tp4-mtp-k5.qualification: Experimental, never the default: tp4-mtp at five draft tokens on the zai-org FP8 checkpoint, served on the text package (--modalities text). Create allocates seven KDA state copies per slot instead of tp4-mtp's five, which the capacity plan puts at 366,400 KV tokens for 32 slots against 665,792; the plan leaves no KV pool for five drafts at 32 slots in a package serving images. qual.json's k5 configuration passed its checks in GATES4 (part A, the autoregressive arms, at cab96b599; part B at 8c75e90bd), adopted by the operator on 2026-10-11, but the profile stays experimental: a benchmark arm, never selected by default.

tp4-ar.qualification: Qualified through 32 sequences: autoregressive on the zai-org FP8 checkpoint. Each declaration's autoregressive arms (determinism, spec_verify and verify_exact records) passed in GATES4 (part A, the autoregressive arms, at cab96b599; part B at 8c75e90bd), adopted by the operator on 2026-10-11, and every MTP record equals its autoregressive arm bit for bit. 32 is its default and its qualified maximum, as it is the default serving cap of every model and profile; 64 is an opt-in only where qualified evidence covers it, and none covers GLM at 64.

tp4-mtp-dcp2.qualification: Qualified through 32 sequences: tp4-mtp at context-parallel size 2 (the latent attention's KV split across two ranks). Its output is not bitwise equal to DCP 1, so qual.json's dcp2 configuration gates it on its own; its gate passed in GATES4 (part A, the autoregressive arms, at cab96b599; part B at 8c75e90bd), adopted by the operator on 2026-10-11 (teacher 0.0640).

tp4-mtp-dcp4.qualification: Qualified through 32 sequences: tp4-mtp at context-parallel size 4 (the latent attention's KV split across four ranks). Its output is not bitwise equal to DCP 1, so qual.json's dcp4 configuration gates it on its own; its gate passed in GATES4 (part A, the autoregressive arms, at cab96b599; part B at 8c75e90bd), adopted by the operator on 2026-10-11 (teacher 0.0658, chat 0.185 against 0.20, so no chat waiver applies).
